Resource Profile: AT APS Composition

Official URL: https://fhir.hl7.at/elga/aps/r4/StructureDefinition/at-aps-composition Version: 0.2.0
Active as of 2026-01-29 Computable Name: AtApsComposition

Das AT APS-Profil für die Composition-Ressource berücksichtigt zum einen die österreichischen Vorgaben (z.B. Patient und zu verwendende Value-Sets) und stellt andererseits die Konformität gegenüber dem IPS-Profil sicher, indem die so genannte imposeProfile-Erweiterung verwendet wird.

Usages:

  • Use this Profile: AT APS Bundle
  • Refer to this Profile: AT APS Composition and AT APS Procedure
  • CapabilityStatements using this Profile: AT APS CapabilityStatement (Server)

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
aps-comp-1 error Composition For automatically generated APS an attester is not allowed (author.resolve().ofType(Device).count() != author.count() or attester.count() = 0)
cmp-1 error Composition.section, Composition.section:sectionMedications, Composition.section:sectionAllergies, Composition.section:sectionProblems, Composition.section:sectionProceduresHx, Composition.section:sectionMedicalDevices, Composition.section:sectionImmunizations, Composition.section:sectionResults, Composition.section:sectionVitalSigns, Composition.section:sectionPastIllnessHx, Composition.section:sectionFunctionalStatus, Composition.section:sectionPlanOfCare, Composition.section:sectionSocialHistory, Composition.section:sectionPregnancyHx, Composition.section:sectionAdvanceDirectives, Composition.section:sectionAlerts, Composition.section:sectionPatientStory A section must contain at least one of text, entries, or sub-sections text.exists() or entry.exists() or section.exists()
cmp-2 error Composition.section, Composition.section:sectionMedications, Composition.section:sectionAllergies, Composition.section:sectionProblems, Composition.section:sectionProceduresHx, Composition.section:sectionMedicalDevices, Composition.section:sectionImmunizations, Composition.section:sectionResults, Composition.section:sectionVitalSigns, Composition.section:sectionPastIllnessHx, Composition.section:sectionFunctionalStatus, Composition.section:sectionPlanOfCare, Composition.section:sectionSocialHistory, Composition.section:sectionPregnancyHx, Composition.section:sectionAdvanceDirectives, Composition.section:sectionAlerts, Composition.section:sectionPatientStory A section can only have an emptyReason if it is empty emptyReason.empty() or entry.empty()
dom-2 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources contained.contained.empty()
dom-3 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()
dom-4 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a meta.versionId or a meta.lastUpdated contained.meta.versionId.empty() and contained.meta.lastUpdated.empty()
dom-5 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a security label contained.meta.security.empty()
dom-6 best practice Composition A resource should have narrative for robust management text.`div`.exists()
ele-1 error **ALL** elements All FHIR elements must have a @value or children hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1 error **ALL** extensions Must have either extensions or value[x], not both extension.exists() != value.exists()
ips-comp-1 error Composition.section:sectionProceduresHx, Composition.section:sectionMedicalDevices Either section.entry or emptyReason are present (entry.reference.exists() or emptyReason.exists())

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
aps-comp-1 error Composition For automatically generated APS an attester is not allowed (author.resolve().ofType(Device).count() != author.count() or attester.count() = 0)
cmp-1 error Composition.section, Composition.section:sectionMedications, Composition.section:sectionAllergies, Composition.section:sectionProblems, Composition.section:sectionProceduresHx, Composition.section:sectionMedicalDevices, Composition.section:sectionImmunizations, Composition.section:sectionResults, Composition.section:sectionVitalSigns, Composition.section:sectionPastIllnessHx, Composition.section:sectionFunctionalStatus, Composition.section:sectionPlanOfCare, Composition.section:sectionSocialHistory, Composition.section:sectionPregnancyHx, Composition.section:sectionAdvanceDirectives, Composition.section:sectionAlerts, Composition.section:sectionPatientStory A section must contain at least one of text, entries, or sub-sections text.exists() or entry.exists() or section.exists()
cmp-2 error Composition.section, Composition.section:sectionMedications, Composition.section:sectionAllergies, Composition.section:sectionProblems, Composition.section:sectionProceduresHx, Composition.section:sectionMedicalDevices, Composition.section:sectionImmunizations, Composition.section:sectionResults, Composition.section:sectionVitalSigns, Composition.section:sectionPastIllnessHx, Composition.section:sectionFunctionalStatus, Composition.section:sectionPlanOfCare, Composition.section:sectionSocialHistory, Composition.section:sectionPregnancyHx, Composition.section:sectionAdvanceDirectives, Composition.section:sectionAlerts, Composition.section:sectionPatientStory A section can only have an emptyReason if it is empty emptyReason.empty() or entry.empty()
dom-2 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources contained.contained.empty()
dom-3 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()
dom-4 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a meta.versionId or a meta.lastUpdated contained.meta.versionId.empty() and contained.meta.lastUpdated.empty()
dom-5 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a security label contained.meta.security.empty()
dom-6 best practice Composition A resource should have narrative for robust management text.`div`.exists()
ele-1 error **ALL** elements All FHIR elements must have a @value or children hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1 error **ALL** extensions Must have either extensions or value[x], not both extension.exists() != value.exists()
ips-comp-1 error Composition.section:sectionProceduresHx, Composition.section:sectionMedicalDevices Either section.entry or emptyReason are present (entry.reference.exists() or emptyReason.exists())

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
aps-comp-1 error Composition For automatically generated APS an attester is not allowed (author.resolve().ofType(Device).count() != author.count() or attester.count() = 0)
cmp-1 error Composition.section, Composition.section:sectionMedications, Composition.section:sectionAllergies, Composition.section:sectionProblems, Composition.section:sectionProceduresHx, Composition.section:sectionMedicalDevices, Composition.section:sectionImmunizations, Composition.section:sectionResults, Composition.section:sectionVitalSigns, Composition.section:sectionPastIllnessHx, Composition.section:sectionFunctionalStatus, Composition.section:sectionPlanOfCare, Composition.section:sectionSocialHistory, Composition.section:sectionPregnancyHx, Composition.section:sectionAdvanceDirectives, Composition.section:sectionAlerts, Composition.section:sectionPatientStory A section must contain at least one of text, entries, or sub-sections text.exists() or entry.exists() or section.exists()
cmp-2 error Composition.section, Composition.section:sectionMedications, Composition.section:sectionAllergies, Composition.section:sectionProblems, Composition.section:sectionProceduresHx, Composition.section:sectionMedicalDevices, Composition.section:sectionImmunizations, Composition.section:sectionResults, Composition.section:sectionVitalSigns, Composition.section:sectionPastIllnessHx, Composition.section:sectionFunctionalStatus, Composition.section:sectionPlanOfCare, Composition.section:sectionSocialHistory, Composition.section:sectionPregnancyHx, Composition.section:sectionAdvanceDirectives, Composition.section:sectionAlerts, Composition.section:sectionPatientStory A section can only have an emptyReason if it is empty emptyReason.empty() or entry.empty()
dom-2 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources contained.contained.empty()
dom-3 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()
dom-4 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a meta.versionId or a meta.lastUpdated contained.meta.versionId.empty() and contained.meta.lastUpdated.empty()
dom-5 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a security label contained.meta.security.empty()
dom-6 best practice Composition A resource should have narrative for robust management text.`div`.exists()
ele-1 error **ALL** elements All FHIR elements must have a @value or children hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1 error **ALL** extensions Must have either extensions or value[x], not both extension.exists() != value.exists()
ips-comp-1 error Composition.section:sectionProceduresHx, Composition.section:sectionMedicalDevices Either section.entry or emptyReason are present (entry.reference.exists() or emptyReason.exists())

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
aps-comp-1 error Composition For automatically generated APS an attester is not allowed (author.resolve().ofType(Device).count() != author.count() or attester.count() = 0)
cmp-1 error Composition.section, Composition.section:sectionMedications, Composition.section:sectionAllergies, Composition.section:sectionProblems, Composition.section:sectionProceduresHx, Composition.section:sectionMedicalDevices, Composition.section:sectionImmunizations, Composition.section:sectionResults, Composition.section:sectionVitalSigns, Composition.section:sectionPastIllnessHx, Composition.section:sectionFunctionalStatus, Composition.section:sectionPlanOfCare, Composition.section:sectionSocialHistory, Composition.section:sectionPregnancyHx, Composition.section:sectionAdvanceDirectives, Composition.section:sectionAlerts, Composition.section:sectionPatientStory A section must contain at least one of text, entries, or sub-sections text.exists() or entry.exists() or section.exists()
cmp-2 error Composition.section, Composition.section:sectionMedications, Composition.section:sectionAllergies, Composition.section:sectionProblems, Composition.section:sectionProceduresHx, Composition.section:sectionMedicalDevices, Composition.section:sectionImmunizations, Composition.section:sectionResults, Composition.section:sectionVitalSigns, Composition.section:sectionPastIllnessHx, Composition.section:sectionFunctionalStatus, Composition.section:sectionPlanOfCare, Composition.section:sectionSocialHistory, Composition.section:sectionPregnancyHx, Composition.section:sectionAdvanceDirectives, Composition.section:sectionAlerts, Composition.section:sectionPatientStory A section can only have an emptyReason if it is empty emptyReason.empty() or entry.empty()
dom-2 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources contained.contained.empty()
dom-3 error Composition If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()
dom-4 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a meta.versionId or a meta.lastUpdated contained.meta.versionId.empty() and contained.meta.lastUpdated.empty()
dom-5 error Composition If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a security label contained.meta.security.empty()
dom-6 best practice Composition A resource should have narrative for robust management text.`div`.exists()
ele-1 error **ALL** elements All FHIR elements must have a @value or children hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1 error **ALL** extensions Must have either extensions or value[x], not both extension.exists() != value.exists()
ips-comp-1 error Composition.section:sectionProceduresHx, Composition.section:sectionMedicalDevices Either section.entry or emptyReason are present (entry.reference.exists() or emptyReason.exists())
